The draft defers inclusion of a migration parity matrix to later, so the spec itself does not define migration parity before implementation as required.

Migration mapping is described only at module level (flow-context.js/base-command.js/dispatcher.js/registry.js) and does not map each inventoried public behavior to a specific new owner or explicit removal decision.

The listed verification targets (help parity, null-spec mismatch, pre-side-effect rejection, post-prepare guards) do not provide behavior-level verification for each retained public surface in the behavior inventory.
